stem: What is one difference between the animals featured in the two selections?

options.label: F
options.text: Ricochet was able to stay with her owner, but Confetti had to leave her owner in order to do her job.

options.label: G
options.text: Ricochet's duties are typical for a service animal, but Confetti performs tasks that are not usually done by an animal.

options.label: H
options.text: Ricochet’s owner believed she would make a good guide animal, but Confetti's owner worried that she would not make a good guide animal.

options.label: J
options.text: Ricochet must stay at home with her trainer, but Confetti travels as part of her job.
